name: Reply triage
description: Sort a reply to a sales email and catch stop requests.
use_when: Every inbound reply to cold email or follow up, before any person or AI writes back.

thresholds.always_review_if: stop_request is high but reply_type is not unsubscribe

reply_type.instructions: What type of reply is this message to a sales email

criteria.interested: The sender wants to talk, see a demo or get details
criteria.not_now: The sender may be interested later and asks to be contacted later
criteria.not_interested: The sender says no and is not interested
criteria.wrong_person: The sender says they are not the right person or points to someone else
criteria.unsubscribe: The sender asks to stop receiving messages
criteria.question: The sender asks a question before deciding

stop_request.instructions: The sender asks to stop receiving messages or to be removed from the list

urgency.instructions: How quickly this reply needs a human answer
